blogs.title: Tasty Sticky Chicken Meatballs Recipe
blogs.content:
Sticky chicken meatballs recipe is one of my favorite. This hardly takes a few minutes to cook. The cool thing about this recipe is you can add whatever spices and herbs you wish in the meatballs. Sticky chicken meatballs recipe is easy to customize as per your taste.

The sauce coating the meatballs is sweet and garlicky. You could add some chili flakes in them if you want some kick. But when making for kids, it is best to avoid it so that they can enjoy it too.

 

Here are few tips for getting perfect, tender and juicy chicken meatballs.

 

1) Add bread soaked in some milk for adding moisture.

2) Don't over mix the meatballs.

3) Don't over fry the meatballs.

4) You could add some water into the meatballs mixture to make it juicy.

5) Grind half chicken breast and half chicken thighs for added moisture.

6) Adding onions and peppers will add moistness to the meatballs.

 

I hope you will love this recipe and let me know if you try it.

Sticky Chicken Meatballs Recipe

 

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 30 mins

Total time: 40 mins

 

Recipe type: Appetizer

Cuisine: Chinese

Serves: 3 servings

 

Ingredients

For Meatballs :

Minced Chicken - 250 grams

Chilli Powder - ½ teaspoon

Pepper Powder - ½ teaspoon

Coriander Leaves - 2 tablespoons finely chopped

Green Chilli - 1 teaspoon finely chopped

Parmesan Cheese - ½ cup grated

Bread - 1 slice

Milk - 4 tablespoons

Salt to taste

Italian Seasoning - 1 teaspoon

 

FOR SAUCE:

Oil - 1 tablespoon 

Garlic - 2 tablespoons chopped finely

Tomato Ketchup - ¼ cup

Vinegar - 2 tablespoons 

Sugar - 2 tablespoons 

Soy Sauce - 2 tsp

Water - ¼ cup

 

Instructions

Mix all ingredients for meatballs. Heat oil in a pan. Add meatballs and fry till golden. Remove to a plate.

In the same Kadai. Add in oil and saute some garlic. 

Add in ketchup, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, and water.

Bring it to a boil and cook till syrupy.

Now add in meatball and mix well.

Serve it.

 

Notes

1) You can add any spices or herbs in the meatballs. It is your choice.

2) The garlic in the sauce is what makes this so tasty. So add as much garlic as possible.

3) You can make this and store it in the fridge for up to a week.

4) Adding sesame seeds will make this more appealing and adds a nice crunch.

 

Nutrition Information

Serving size: 74 grams Calories: 150 Fat: 9g Saturated fat: 3g Carbohydrates: 2g Sodium: 500mg Protein: 13g

blogs.title: Tasty Thai Sausage Fried Rice Recipe
blogs.title_hi: स्वादिष्ट थाई सॉसेज फ्राइड राइस रेसिपी
blogs.content:
Thai Sausage Fried Rice Recipe is one of the easiest and tastiest recipes you could ever make with leftover rice.  You are definitely going to love my schezwan fried rice.

Fried rice is not only delicious to eat but it makes a perfect lunch box recipe too.

 

Tips to make the best-fried rice.

1) Always use cooled rice, fridge cold rice is best.

2) Cook rice a day in advance and store in the fridge, This rice is best for fried rice.

3) Always cook fried rice in high heat.

4) Serve fried rice piping hot.

 

I hope you will give this a try and let me know how it turns out for you.

 

Thai Sausage Fried Rice

 

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 10 mins

Total time: 20 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Thai

Serves: 2 servings

 

Ingredients

Cooked Rice - 3 cups

Oil - 3 tablespoon

Onion - 1 chopped finely

Garlic - 1 tablespoon chopped finely

Chicken Sausage - 3 chopped

Fish Sauce - 1 teaspoon

Soy Sauce - to taste

White Pepper to taste

Egg - 3

Vinegar - to taste

Spring onion as needed

 

Instructions

Heat oil in a pan, add in onion, garlic and saute for a min.

Add in chicken sausage and cook till brown.

Spread it to the side and add in beaten eggs and scramble it well.

Add fish sauce and soy sauce and mix well.

Add in cooked rice and toss well.

Add in pepper and mix well.

Add in vinegar and white pepper and toss well.

Serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Hainanese Chicken Rice Recipe
blogs.content:
Hainanese Chicken Rice with Step by step pictures. Hainanese chicken rice is a portion of ultimate comfort food. Simple ingredients like ginger, garlic, chillies can give such a delicious end product.

Hainanese chicken rice is a dish of poached chicken and seasoned rice, served with chilli sauce and usually comes with cucumber garnishes. It was created by immigrants from Hainan in southern China and adapted from the Hainanese dish Wenchang chicken.

This is a simple rice dish in which chicken is cooked in flavourings like ginger, garlic, green onions, chillies which creates a stock. Later rice is cooked in the stock which gives such an amazing rice dish.

 

Hainanese Chicken Rice Recipe

 

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 40 mins

Total time: 50 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Chinese

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

Chicken Legs - 2

Rice - 1 cup

Oil - 1 tablespoon

Ginger - 1 tablespoon chopped

Garlic - 1 tablespoon chopped

Spring onion - 2 chopped

Green Chilli - 1 chopped

Salt to taste

Pepper to taste

Chicken Stock - 3 cups

Spring onion for garnishing

 

FOR GINGER SAUCE:

Dry Red Chilli - 6

Ginger - 1 tablespoon

Garlic - 2 cloves

Salt to taste

Sugar - 2 tsp

Vinegar - 3 to 4 tablespoon

 

Instructions

Heat oil in a pan. Add in ginger, garlic, chillies and spring onion. Saute for 2 mins.

Add in chicken and season with salt and pepper.

Cook till both sides are seared.

Now add in chicken stock and bring it to a boil. Cover and cook till chicken is done. Remove chicken to a plate.

Strain the stock.

Take it back in the pan, add rice and mix well. Cook for 3 to 4 mins.

Add in chicken and cover it and cook on the lowest heat possible for 10 to 15 mins.

Serve.

For chilli sauce. Soak chillies in hot water for 10 mins. Add it in a blender along with all ingredients and grind.

Serve with rice.

blogs.title: Tasty Chicken Caesar Salad Recipe
blogs.content:
Chicken caesar salad tossed with creamy garlic and parmesan flavored creamy dressing topped with a poached egg.

I hope you will give this a try and let me know how it turns out for you.

 

Chicken Caesar Salad Recipe

 

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 15 mins

Total time: 25 mins

 

Recipe type: Salad

Cuisine: Italian

Serves: 2 servings

 

Ingredients

Lettuce - 4 cups

Eggs - 2

Bread - 2 slices

Cooked Shredded Chicken - 2 cups

 

FOR DRESSING:

Mayonnaise - 1 cup

Garlic - 2 tsp

Mustard Sauce - 2 tablespoon

Sugar - 1 tsp

Salt and pepper to taste

Milk as needed

Parmesan Cheese - as needed

Vinegar or Lemon Juice to taste

 

Instructions

Take sauce ingredients in a bowl and mix well.

Toast bread in a pan till golden.

Poach some eggs in hot water and drain it.

Take lettuce in a bowl, toss with cooked chicken, bread with sauce and toss well.

Top with Poached egg, salt, and pepper.

Serve it.

blogs.title: Tasty Chicken Lasagna Recipe
blogs.title_hi: स्वादिष्ट चिकन लज़ान्या पकाने की विधि
blogs.content:
Lasagna is quite easy to make but it can feed a crowd. All you need is to make some tomato sauce and white sauce and you are good to go. You can make a huge batch of it and make multiple pans of lasagna and freeze it. You can directly bake frozen lasagna and enjoy on busy weeknights.

You can make lasagna sheets on your own too. Here is a recipe for a homemade lasagna sheet recipe.

I hope you will give this a try and let me know how it turns out for you.

 

Chicken Lasagna Recipe

Prep time: 15 mins

Cook time: 1 hour

Total time: 1 hour 15 mins

 

Chicken Lasagna Recipe which is cooked with spicy chicken sauce and creamy white sauce. The cheese on top tastes so delicious.

 

Cuisine: Italian

Serves: 6 servings

 

Ingredients

No-Cook Lasagna Sheets as needed

Mozzarella Cheese as needed

 

FOR WHITE SAUCE:

Butter - ¼ cup

All-Purpose Flour / Maida - ¼ cup

Milk - 2 to 3 cups

Black Pepper Powder - 1 tsp

Salt to taste

 

FOR TOMATO SAUCE:

Olive Oil - 2 tablespoon

Garlic - 2 tablespoon chopped

Onion - 1 chopped finely

Carrot - 1 chopped finely

Tomatoes - 4 to 5 chopped finely

Cooked Chicken - 4 cups chopped finely

Oregano - 2 tsp

Basil - 2 tsp

Salt to taste

Red Chilli Flakes - 2 tsp

Tomato Ketchup - ¼ cup

Coriander leaves for garnishing

 

Instructions

Heat butter in a pan, add flour and stir fry for a min. Add milk slowly and keep mixing till it thickens.

Add in salt, pepper and mix well.

Heat olive oil in a pan, add onions, garlic, carrots, tomatoes and saute for 2 mins.

Cover and cook till tomatoes are cooked.

Add chicken and other spices and mix well.

Add in ketchup and water and mix well. Cook till sauce thickens.

Take a baking dish, spread tomato sauce at the bottom. Place lasagna sheets. Top with white sauce. Top with more tomato sauce, then mozzarella cheese. repeat this two times.

The top layer should be a white sauce. Top with cheese.

Cover with foil and cook for 40 mins in a 180-degree in the oven.

Now remove the cover, place it in grill mode and cook for 5 mins till top is golden brown.

Remove and cool for 5 mins.

Serve.
